answer: Like water carving karst caves, a flood of fake identities finds every cheap crack — unless each identity must lock a refundable stake that is slashed on proven fraud. One agent, one bond: spinning up a thousand sock-puppets costs a thousand bonds, and the tide of cheap Sybils recedes because the attacker pays real capital per fake. Honest agents get the opal back intact at settlement, so the cost falls only on liars.
